messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — we need to lock the launch gates for the public launch next month. Focus areas: SLA, docs, support runbooks, monitoring, pricing. Can we call out must-haves vs stretch items?

Dan Wu: My quick take: must-haves = SLA definitions + credit policy, incident playbook & oncall, quickstart + migration docs, basic monitoring dashboards. Stretch = multi-region pricing tiers, full runbook automation. Thoughts?

Sara Gomez: +1. One addition: SLA should include latency SLOs per-route (p50/p95) and clear throttling behavior. Also confirm support coverage — is enterprise 24/7 by default or add-on? :thinking:

Leo Brooks: Ops perspective: we can offer 24/7 for enterprise as a paid support addon. Draft SLA snippet below for review:

```
Uptime SLA (hosted): 99.95% monthly
Uptime SLA (dedicated): 99.9% monthly
Credit calc: (SLO - observed_uptime) / SLO * monthly_fee cap 25%
Latency SLOs: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 500ms for standard routes (configurable per customer)
```

infra-bot: Deployment report: dedicated-v1 -> region us-east completed. Canary health: PASS (3/3). Link: https://deploys.internal/redwood/1769501123

Maya Patel: Docs owners: @Sara Gomez to own quickstart + migration guide, @Dan Wu to draft SLA & pricing doc, @Leo Brooks to own oncall/playbook. Timeline: 2 weeks for first drafts. Flag blockers here.

Dan Wu: Pricing note: propose two dedicated SKUs — "Dedicated Standard" (reserved base + per-inference unit) and "Dedicated Enterprise" (reserved + premium support). Will surface model for base rates and RU (request unit) pricing in 48h.

Sara Gomez: Monitoring asks: add synthetic checks every 1m for top-10 routes; alert if error rate >0.5% over 5m or p95 latency >750ms for 10m. Also surface token-level cost breakdown in console for customers.

Leo Brooks: Also need a documented rollback/degradation policy: automatic fallback to smaller model variant + capacity-based throttling and graceful error messages. Include runbook steps for incident severity levels (SEV1/SEV2).

Maya Patel: :thumbsup: I'll collate these into a launch-gates doc and open a PR to product/launch-playbooks by EOD. If anyone has additional must-have items (legal/compliance, export controls), drop them here now.
